Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single raster balance-of-power UI emblem for Hearts of Iron IV, eventual export 78x88 pixels. Create the emblem for the Captains' Collegium, a collective military council. A compact round dark gunmetal medallion with antique gold rim and thick golden laurel branches along left and right lower sides, tied together at the bottom. Within the dark circle, exactly three dignified military officer head-and-shoulder busts sculpted as simplified silver and muted gold metal relief, facing forward: one central officer slightly forward, two flank officers behind, conveying collective command. No realistic skin colors, all figures are embossed metal, no tiny detailed faces. A small simple dark command-table edge across the lower interior can ground the busts but do not overcrowd. Match traditional grand-strategy UI icon finish: hand-painted metallic highlights, bevels, aged gold warm yellow edges, dark recessed steel center, very crisp readable silhouette, top-left highlights and lower-right shadows. Nearly circular badge centered in a slightly taller 39:44 canvas, with about 10 percent transparent space around silhouette and a little more space above and below. Transparent background outside the complete medallion, no rectangle, no drop shadow outside it. No letters, no text, no numbers, no modern flat vector look, no jewels, no crown, no flags, no stars, no weapons. One isolated icon only, not an icon sheet. The design must remain clear at 78x88 pixels. The paired icon is a dark metal roundel with gold laurels and crossed silver swords; match that metallic palette and visual weight while keeping the three officer busts as this emblem's subject.
